_help.what: Which stimuli of each recording are used for clustering. Read by build_master_file.py. Edit freely; re-run the builder with FORCE for a recording to apply changes.
_help.groups: Flash groups: each group lists the stimulus index of [scf, csteps, chirp]. Use null when that stimulus is missing in a group. Group 1 is the first presentation.
_help.moving_bar: Stimulus indices of the moving bar (8 directions x 300 frames, should be 10 repeats).
_help.rf: Noise stimulus used for the receptive field: stimulus index, channel name inside noise_data_v2.nc, and the file (relative to the phase folder). null = no RF data.
_help.region: Where on the retina the recording was made (e.g. 'dorsal', 'ventral'). Fill in later; can be changed without re-extracting spikes.
_help.notes: Free text, copied into the master file.
